review_focus: correctness of the single full-height workspace with the compact/fullscreen-toggle mode still removed
runtime measurement of the actual wrapped workspace dock height rather than another fixed mobile offset
status live-region clearance for one-row and two-row docks with the download link both hidden and visible
legacy draw.io dynamically reserves both right-side close clearance and the actual bottom dock height while native mode remains full-height
320x740 and 760x900 browser geometry in native and legacy modes, including post-export wrapped download controls
engine-specific export availability remains unchanged: native Inhalt/Quelle/SVG and legacy Projekt/PNG/SVG plus prepared download
publication successor binding supersedes the four revised product/test hashes without rewriting historical acceptance

iterations.finding: The current-head Codex threads identified that a full-width mobile action dock could still obscure the status region, especially after the prepared download link increases dock height.
iterations.resolution: Reproduced the material case at 320x740 on 4d49b1c: the two-row native dock measured 102 px and overlapped the status region by 28 px.

iterations.finding: A larger fixed bottom offset would only move the failure boundary and would not cover future dock-height changes.
iterations.resolution: Replaced the fixed mobile status offset with an actual-height invariant: ResizeObserver publishes the dock height as a CSS variable, and status position is computed from dock bottom, measured height and an 8 px gap.

iterations.finding: Legacy draw.io also needs canvas clearance when the export dock grows after a prepared download appears.
iterations.resolution: Bound the legacy editor-stage bottom padding to the same measured dock-height variable while preserving explicit right-side close clearance.

iterations.finding: The final responsive state needed direct geometry evidence, not selector-only tests.
iterations.resolution: Browser readbacks covered native and legacy at 320x740 and 760x900 before and after export: wrapped states have zero status/dock overlap, 8 px status-to-dock clearance, and legacy retains 8 px frame-to-dock and frame-to-close clearance.

iterations.finding: Changing the four accepted implementation/test revisions invalidated the prior mobile-status source bindings.
iterations.resolution: Added a new immutable wrapped-dock successor receipt plus publication-fixture precedence; then reran the complete exact-head validation with Ruff, compile, registry validation and 1656 tests passing.
